---
title: "News"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/js-yaml/4.1.0/js-yaml.min.js"></script>
---

<style>
  /* --- GLOBAL CARD COLOR THEME --- */
  :root {
    --card-bg: #f4f9fc; 
    --card-border: #031C59; 
    --text-main: #031C59; 
  }

  html[data-bs-theme="dark"], body.quarto-dark, [data-bs-theme="dark"] {
    --card-bg: rgba(198, 198, 198, 0.1);
    --card-border: #99ddff;
    --text-main: #f3f3f3;
  }

  /* --- NEWS CARD STYLES (TIMELINE SYNC) --- */
  .news-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    border-left: 5px solid var(--card-border); 
    border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; 
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
  }

  .news-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 15px rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.15); 
  }

  .news-img-zone {
    flex: 0 0 220px;
    background: #ffffff;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  }

  .news-img-zone img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }

  .news-content-zone {
    padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .news-category-meta {
    color: var(--card-border);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  .news-card-title {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }

  /* --- DETAIL VIEW STYLES --- */
  .news-detail-container { display: none; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease; }
  .news-detail-container.active { display: block; }
  @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

  .back-btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    color: var(--text-main); padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 30px; transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  .back-btn:hover { background: rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.1); }

  .detail-journal-title { font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-main); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .detail-journal-meta { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--card-border); margin-bottom: 30px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--card-border); padding-bottom: 10px; }
  .detail-journal-content { font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.8; text-align: justify; }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .news-card { flex-direction: column; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 1px solid var(--card-border); border-top: 5px solid var(--card-border); }
    .news-img-zone { flex: auto; height: 180px; border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }
  }
</style>

:::: {style='margin-top: 3em;'}
::::

<!-- APP WRAPPER -->
<div id="news-app">

<!-- LIST VIEW -->
<div id="list-view"></div>

<!-- DETAIL VIEW -->
<div id="detail-view" class="news-detail-container">
<button class="back-btn" onclick="closeNewsDetail()">← Back to Journal</button>
<img id="detail-img" style="width:100%; max-height:400px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:12px; margin-bottom:30px;" src="">
<h1 id="detail-title" class="detail-journal-title"></h1>
<div id="detail-meta" class="detail-journal-meta"></div>
<div id="detail-content" class="detail-journal-content"></div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
  let newsData = [];

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    fetch('posts/news_data.yml')
      .then(res => res.text())
      .then(yaml => {
        newsData = jsyaml.load(yaml);
        newsData.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date));
        renderNewsList();
      });
  });

  function renderNewsList() {
    const list = document.getElementById('list-view');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    newsData.forEach((item, index) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'news-card';
      card.onclick = () => openNewsDetail(index);
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="news-img-zone">
          <img src="${item.image}" alt="${item.title}">
        </div>
        <div class="news-content-zone">
          <div class="news-category-meta">${item.category} | ${new Date(item.date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {month:'long', year:'numeric'})}</div>
          <h3 class="news-card-title">${item.title}</h3>
          <p style="margin:0; line-height:1.5;">${item.short_description}</p>
        </div>
      `;
      list.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function openNewsDetail(index) {
    const item = newsData[index];
    document.getElementById('list-view').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('detail-view').classList.add('active');
    
    document.getElementById('detail-img').src = item.image;
    document.getElementById('detail-title').innerText = item.title;
    document.getElementById('detail-meta').innerText = `${item.category} • Published on ${new Date(item.date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {day:'numeric', month:'long', year:'numeric'})}`;
    document.getElementById('detail-content').innerHTML = item.full_content;
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  function closeNewsDetail() {
    document.getElementById('detail-view').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('list-view').style.display = 'block';
  }
</script>
